messages.author: 807b1956560c3f8f
messages.subject: Windows version of rstan2.0..1
parts:
Hello,

Thank you very much for your efforts, I could compile without problems version 2.0.1
and the school example runs fine :D

Anyway, I think the original tar package is not located in

http://wiki.rstan-repo.googlecode.com/git/

As it is noted in the instructions page, but really in

http://wiki.rstan-repo.googlecode.com/git/src/contrib/

I used also the command

R CMD INSTALL --build rstan_2.0.1.tar.gz

and I obtained a x64 version of the library for windows 64bits

You can locate in

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/21286756/rstan_2.0.1.zip

Just it can be installed by using the naive option from the R main menu:
In Packages:
Install package(s) from local zip files...

Perhaps it may be useful for any windows user

Greetings!

messages.author: 807b1956560c3f8f
messages.subject: Re: Windows version of rstan2.0..1
parts:
Well, I forgot saying that it is included also the version x86 (32 bits) for windows in the package that I uploaded.

because I used command

R CMD INSTALL --build rstan_2.0.1.tar.gz --merge-multiarch
